modeReason: Several top stories clear the relevance threshold of 8: the Character.AI private-chat auction fight and the FCC's approval of up to a million orbiting AI-datacenter satellites each score 12 (novelty 3 x magnitude 2 x breadth 2).
phrase: Regulators are fighting a company's plan to auction off millions of private chats, including children's. Meanwhile, a company won approval to send up to a million AI datacenters into space.
phraseAlternatives: A bankruptcy sale wants to auction off millions of private chats, some from children, despite state objections. Meanwhile, a rocket company can launch a million AI datacenters into space.
States are trying to block a company from selling millions of users' private chats, including children's. Elsewhere, regulators cleared the way for up to a million orbiting AI datacenters.
Millions of private chats, some from children, are headed for a bankruptcy auction unless states stop it. Meanwhile, the sky may soon fill with up to a million AI datacenters.
One company's private chats are for sale, children's included, and regulators are racing to stop it. Another company just got the green light to put AI datacenters into orbit.

brief.concept: A company tries to auction off a vault of millions of users' private chats, children's included, while regulators reach up to stop the sale; at the same moment, a rocket company launches a ring of small AI-datacenter satellites into orbit above them.
brief.metaphor: Private secrets become merchandise on the ground while computing power quietly colonizes the sky.

brief.composition: Split frame with a thin horizon line. Left half, ground level: a vault-shaped building leans over, pouring glowing speech-bubble chats down toward an auctioneer's hammer; a human hand reaches up from below to catch and stop part of the stream, with one small child-shaped icon visible among the falling bubbles. Right half, sky: a rocket lifts off a launch pad and arcs up into a ring of small satellite-datacenters circling a simple curved Earth silhouette; one satellite window shows a small robot waving. Keep each half to two main shapes so the cut-paper layers stay clean.
brief.alt: On one side, a vault-shaped building spills glowing chat bubbles toward an auction hammer while a hand reaches up to stop it, with a child's icon among the bubbles. On the other side, a rocket launches toward a ring of small satellites orbiting Earth, with a tiny robot waving from one of them.
